title: UNITED WE TRIBE
short_description: A full-day gathering of cacao, singing, dancing, live music and open circle. Explore heart-to-heart connections, express yourself freely and celebrate life together as one tribe. A space for joy, vulnerability and self-expression.
description:
🌟 UNITED WE TRIBE 🌟
CACAO · SINGING CIRCLE · ECSTATIC DANCE · LIVE MUSIC · OPEN CIRCLE

A full-day gathering to open our hearts and create a space for joy through cacao, singing, and dancing as one tribe.

We open with cacao to awaken our energy, explore 4 different themes, each with a heart-to-heart practice and a song to sing together.

We move, dance and express ourselves in whatever way we want, before opening the circle to your medicine: song, poetry or anything your heart wishes to share.

**🔥 PROGRAM**
13:00 · Doors Open
14:00 · Ceremony
17:30 · Break & Snacks
18:00 · Ecstatic Dance
19:30 · Dinner
20:30 · Live Music
21:00 · Open Circle
22:00 · Closing

📅 Sat 21 Nov
📍 Essência Nature Retreat, Aljezur https://maps.app.goo.gl/TSz54i3YQMqWvPsH9

🎟 **FULL DAY**
• Early bird · €29 (until Tue 17 Nov)
• Regular · €36 (until Fri 20 Nov)
• At the door · €40

🌿 A MEDICINE LIFE: https://go.amedicine.life/links

***

**🍲 FOOD**

**Vegan & gluten-free meal** available on-site at extra cost:
🥣 Pre-booked · €7
🍽️ On-site · €9
You can also bring your own food if you prefer.

⚠️ _Allergies? Please let us know about any allergies or food sensitivities before the event:_ https://go.amedicine.life/dm

***

**👧 KIDS**

Kids up to 12 years old are welcome and come for free. Please look after them if they become loud during ceremony moments, out of respect for the collective space.

***

**⏰ TIME**

Arriving on time is an act of respect for yourself, for the circle, and for the medicine we create together. We honour time as part of the ritual and we open the ceremony on time.

Doors open 1 hour before the start. We invite you to arrive early: it is part of the journey to ground gently, connect with the tribe, and explore the land.

***

**🍫 CACAO**

Cacao is an ancestral medicine from Central and South America, used in ceremony for thousands of years. It gently opens the heart, deepens presence and emotional connection, and naturally lifts energy.

**FAST OR EAT LIGHT for at least 4 hours before the ceremony starts**, and bring your favourite cup for cacao.

⚠️ _Ceremonial cacao is not suitable for everyone. Please avoid it if you are taking antidepressants (SSRIs/MAOIs), have a heart condition, or high blood pressure. Your wellbeing is sacred to us. Feel free to reach out with any questions._

***

**🎶 SINGING CIRCLE**

We'd love you to bring your musical instruments.

***

**💃 ECSTATIC DANCE** · 3 simple rules

🦶 Barefoot dancing
🚫 No alcohol or mind-altering substances
🤫 No talking during the dance

***

**🎤 OPEN CIRCLE**

Would you like to share a song, a poem, your art, a story, a joke or a performance? The circle is open for you.

***

**🎒 WHAT TO BRING**

Dress in comfortable layers so you can adjust throughout the day and stay comfortable while dancing. Bring a water bottle, your cup for cacao, a musical instrument if you have one, and some cash for food. Most importantly, bring an open heart and your medicine.

***

**📸 PICTURES & VIDEOS**

During the event, photographs and videos may be taken and used for social media and promotional purposes. By attending, you acknowledge and consent to being photographed or filmed. If you do not wish to appear in any photos or videos, please let us know clearly and directly at the event. We will respect your choice and make reasonable efforts to ensure you are not included.

***

**🎟️ TICKET**

Your ticket is non-refundable and valid only for this gathering. If you cannot attend, you are welcome to pass your ticket to someone else. Just let us know their name.

***

**🚗 PARKING**

Please carpool as much as possible to support the group and reduce stress on parking. The road and the land are suitable for big campers too.

***

**🛏️ OVERNIGHT STAY**

You are welcome to stay overnight for **€10** (limited spaces).

***

**🌿 COMMUNITY GUIDELINES**

Essência is a substance-free, plant-based community. Please honour this sacred space by refraining from any substances, including tobacco.

***

_We look forward to gathering as one tribe. Dancing, singing, and sharing in joy, connection, and presence._

_For any question or communication contact us at_ https://go.amedicine.life/dm

_With gratitude and love,_

**A MEDICINE LIFE** 🌿

Follow us for upcoming events, our music, or to explore the vision:

🔗 https://go.amedicine.life/links
